text: Chennai is the capital of Tamil Nadu and a major city blending South Indian traditions, temples, history, beaches and modern urban life.
Chennai highlights include Marina Beach, Fort St. George, Kapaleeshwarar Temple and Parthasarathy Temple, according to Incredible India.
Chennai is served by Chennai International Airport (MAA) and Chennai Central Railway Station (MAS), according to Incredible India.
Chennai's guide recommends South Indian breakfast dishes such as dosa and idli with sambar and chutney, and also highlights Chettinad cuisine and seafood.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
Madurai is a historic Tamil Nadu city known for its temples and spiritual traditions. Incredible India describes it as a city with a long cultural and religious history.
The Madurai guide highlights Sri Meenakshi-Sundareswarar Temple and Gandhi Memorial Museum among its cultural and heritage attractions.
Madurai is served by Madurai Airport (IXM), as listed by Incredible India.
